svg.title: Transureteroureterostomy
svg.desc: A donor ureter crosses retroperitoneally to an end-to-side anastomosis with a suitable recipient ureter, avoiding tension and kinking. Vascular crossing, recipient health and the consequence of risking both renal units require individualized planning. View: Upper urinary tract, simplified anterior view. Scale: Conceptual schematic; not to scale. Units: No measured geometry; any dimensions are illustrative. Clinical review pending; no named clinician has signed off. Concept sources: Iwaszko et al.: transureteroureterostomy revisited (2010 retrospective cohort), https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/20092851/; access: abstract checked; Donor-to-recipient reconstruction; 63 patients with heterogeneous indications, not a universal vascular crossing rule. EAU Urological Trauma: urogenital trauma guidelines (2026 web guideline), https://uroweb.org/guidelines/urological-trauma/chapter/urogenital-trauma-guidelines; access: official full text; Renal injury, bladder rupture and ureteral reconstruction principles; figures omit parts of the management algorithms. WARWIKI original vector schematic; individual illustrator not recorded. No separate figure reuse license recorded; linked sources are concept references, not artwork licenses.

svg.text: Transureteroureterostomy (TUU) — cross to the good ureter
Anterior view: a tension-free retroperitoneal crossing joins the donor to the healthy recipient ureter

g.text: WARWIKI · original schematic · v2026-09-11 · clinical review pending
